title: CameraShaker (RbxCameraShaker)
desc: Open-source camera shake engine: ShakeOnce, sustained shakes, presets, fade in/out.

title: CameraShakeInstance
desc: Single shake instance used by CameraShaker (Perlin noise, fade states).

title: CameraShakePresets
desc: Ready-made shake presets (Explosion, Earthquake, Bump, Handheld...).

title: ShakeCamera wrapper
desc: How a game wraps CameraShaker into one shared module (one instance, simple API).

title: Shake via Humanoid.CameraOffset
desc: Shake without touching Camera.CFrame (uses Humanoid.CameraOffset) + controller vibration.

title: Combat client camera
desc: Additive decaying shake + head-follow CameraOffset + 'dead cam' offset in one LocalScript.

title: Frame-table camera cutscenes
desc: Data-driven cutscenes: per-frame CFrame + FOV tables played at 60 fps relative to a part.

title: Animated camera rig cutscenes
desc: Animate a camera rig with normal animations; camera follows the rig's Cam part; smooth hand-back.

title: CutsceneLock
desc: One-cutscene-at-a-time lock + StreamingEnabled support (load what the camera sees).

title: Kill cam / intro definitions
desc: Data-driven kill cams / intros / outros (rig + animation + FOV curve per cutscene).

title: Lock-on camera
desc: Target lock-on with crosshair picking, left/right switching, line-of-sight break, shoulder offset.

title: Head-follow camera offset
desc: Camera follows the head during animations (CameraOffset = head relative to root).

title: First-person bob, sway & breathing
desc: Best head-bob/sway reference: layered sine + noise offsets with every constant exposed at the top.

title: Realism mode (CloneTrooper1019)
desc: Old but famous: body follows camera pitch + walk bobble via CameraOffset (R6).

title: Jumpscare controller
desc: Full jumpscare: model flies at the camera, shake, flash, color/DOF effects, auto cleanup.

title: Death jumpscare camera
desc: Simplest death cam: Scriptable camera at a fixed part + FOV kick (120 -> 50).

title: Spectate client (follow cam)
desc: Clean spectate: freeze input, lerp-follow target, survive respawns, full restore.

title: Spectate next/previous
desc: The simplest spectate: cycle Camera.CameraSubject through a player list.

title: FOV / blur helper
desc: Two-function helper to tween FOV and blur.

title: Orbit pan camera
desc: Orbiting showcase camera with simple wall collision (repeated raycasts ignoring see-through parts).

title: CinematicCutscene (pattern)
desc: Plays a list of camera shots with letterbox bars, input freeze, skip button and a smooth hand-back.

title: FovController (pattern)
desc: Single owner of FieldOfView: base FOV (sprint), named offsets (aim), and spring FOV punches.

title: DeathCam (pattern)
desc: On death, orbit the body or frame the killer, desaturate, and restore on respawn.
